description: THEY RESPOND TO YOUR RUN If you’re looking for the most cushioned running experience, you’re looking at the absolute shoe – the nike Zoom Vomero+ 5. A refined performance classic, the nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoe combines the best of its predecessor, the Nike Zoom Vomero, the Vomero+ 5 has an enhanced Fit, smoother ride and lighter weight. In fact, unlike the earlier version, the Vomero+ 5 has a breathable open mesh upper with no-sew overlays through the forefoot to ensure a snug, secure and seam free fit. This style of bonding of the shoe not only enhances support to the foot, it also reduces chaffing and irritation. Weighing an average of just about 329 grams, the Nike Zoom units employed in the sole region of the Nike Zoom Vomero+5 range of shoes ensure lightweight, responsive cushioning, making running an experience to reckon with. Flex and stretch as much as you like An absolute in comfort for underpronators to neutral gait runners with normal to high arches, the Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 falls under the neutral category of running shoes . These shoes have elastic mesh panels for a lockdown and adaptable fit of the feet. The stretch panels work along with the other parts of the shoe and ensure that the middle part of the foot is kept locked and in place, while allowing it to stretch and flex with absolute ease, comfort and support. The Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5, which weighs an average of 278 grams for women’s shoes and 329 grams for men’s shoes, has an external heel counter that wraps around the heel for a snug fit. What comes as a cherry on the icing with the Nike Vomero+ 5 shoe is the inner-sleeve or bootie for a plush fit and comfort. The Vomero+ 5, in fact, is much loved by runners for its heel and forefoot responsive cushioning created by the Nike Zoom units, besides, of course, a full length, soft midsole for added durability and cushioning. Segmented heel for quick moves The Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoe has a crash pad below the heel that is more segmented than its earlier models. This ensures better shock absorption, smoother transition and cushioning when the heel strikes the ground. There are extensions of blown rubber infused in the heel to provide a smoother and more efficient stride even when enhancing cushioning. There is an additional injected phylon (IP) pressure path under the arch to ensure that the feet are in contact with the ground, adding to the stability and impact guidance system factor. Safe runs at dusk All of the Nike Zoom Vomero+ 5 shoes are constructed with reflective elements so that runners can enjoy their sport even under low visibility, with safety. These shoes also come with arch supports to ensure stability while the feet move naturally. There are, in fact, multiple types or rubber and traction patterns employed to ensure that the running stride is kept smooth, allowing the knees and feet to stay in shape. With flex grooves in place, there’s an abundance of flexibility and smooth, efficient runs that you can earn with this Nike+ range. Add on Nike+ compatible products like your goal and workout monitors and there’s no stopping you. description: EXPERIENCE THE JOY OF FRESH RUNS An absolutely dynamic running shoe, the nike Lunarswift+ offers seamless comfort, distance-busting cushioning and runner specific support. Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a springy effect for the feet. The Nike Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer feel to the underfoot. It’s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the medial and lateral side of the shoe. Breezy touch to snug shoes With a stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot. Adapts to the runner's needs Light in weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the runner’s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer’s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability. No wonder overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting this same shoe into a neutral running shoe. Stay safe in the dark The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions, keeping you safe. Belonging to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+ products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible gauging devices. So enjoy those long runs through all seasons in this pleasurable range of Nike Lunarswift+ shoes.
